nodes.description: mapping(address => uint256) private _balances; stores token balances of every holder.
mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) private _allowances; nested allowance table.
uint256 private _tTotal = 1000*10**9*10**18; total token supply.
string private _name = ' Noelle Inu '; token name.
string private _symbol = 'Noelle'; token symbol.
uint8 private _decimals = 18; token decimals.
address private _owner; declared owner slot written in constructor and transferOwnership.
address private newComer = _msgSender(); the variable actually checked by the onlyOwner modifier instead of _owner.
constructor() public: mints entire _tTotal to _msgSender() and sets _owner.
approve(address spender, uint256 amount) public: forwards to _approve with _msgSender().
transferFrom(address sender, address recipient, uint256 amount) public: moves tokens then re-approves spender with reduced allowance.
transfer(address recipient, uint256 amount) public: sends tokens from _msgSender().
_transfer(address sender, address recipient, uint256 amount) internal: SafeMath sub/add on _balances and emits Transfer.
_approve(address ol, address tt, uint256 amount) private: writes _allowances; zeroes allowance when caller is not owner().
allowance(address owner, address spender) public view: reads _allowances.
balanceOf(address account) public view: reads _balances.
totalSupply() public view: returns _tTotal.
name() public view: returns _name.
symbol() public view: returns _symbol.
decimals() public view: returns _decimals.
owner() public view: returns _owner; used by _approve to branch.
renounceOwnership() public virtual onlyOwner: sets _owner to address(0) but leaves newComer intact.
transferOwnership(address newOwner) private onlyOwner: updates _owner only, guarded by newComer.
modifier onlyOwner(): require(newComer == _msgSender()); reads newComer not _owner.
_msgSender() internal view virtual returns (address payable): returns msg.sender.
Address.sendValue(address payable recipient, uint256 amount): forwards ETH through a raw call.
Address._functionCallWithValue(address target, bytes data, uint256 weiValue, string errorMessage): raw call forwarding value and data.
msg.sender: externally controlled caller used for minting, ownership, transfers and approvals.
Low-level recipient.call{value: amount}("") inside Address.sendValue; value transfer to an arbitrary address.
Low-level target.call{value: weiValue}(data) inside Address._functionCallWithValue; arbitrary external call with value.
_allowances[ol][tt] = 0 reset branch emitted when ol != owner(), silently discarding the requested allowance.
address sender parameter of _transfer.
address recipient parameter of _transfer.
uint256 amount parameter of _transfer.
address sender parameter of transferFrom.
address recipient parameter of transferFrom.
uint256 amount parameter of transferFrom.
address spender parameter of approve.
uint256 amount parameter of approve.
uint256 amount parameter of transfer.
address ol (owner-side) parameter of _approve.
address tt (spender-side) parameter of _approve.
uint256 amount parameter of _approve.
address owner parameter of allowance.
address spender parameter of allowance.
address account parameter of balanceOf.
address newOwner parameter of transferOwnership.
address payable recipient parameter of Address.sendValue.
uint256 amount parameter of Address.sendValue.
address msgSender local assigned from _msgSender() in the constructor.
bool success returned by the raw call in Address.sendValue.
bool success returned by the raw call in _functionCallWithValue.
bytes returndata captured from the raw call in _functionCallWithValue.

edges.reason: Constructor mints _tTotal into _balances of the deployer.
Constructor assigns the deployer address into _owner.
_transfer decrements the sender balance and increments the recipient balance through SafeMath.
balanceOf reads the _balances mapping.
_approve writes the nested _allowances table.
allowance reads the nested _allowances table.
transferFrom reads and then rewrites _allowances[sender][msg.sender].
totalSupply returns _tTotal.
name returns _name.
symbol returns _symbol.
decimals returns _decimals.
owner() reads _owner.
renounceOwnership writes address(0) into _owner while newComer keeps the old authority.
transferOwnership writes newOwner into _owner.
newComer state variable is initialized from msg.sender and then used as the only access-control authority instead of _owner.
_msgSender returns msg.sender to every caller-facing function.
Constructor obtains the deployer address via _msgSender().
approve uses _msgSender() as the approving account.
transfer uses _msgSender() as the sending account.
transferFrom uses _msgSender() as the spender whose allowance is decreased.
onlyOwner verifies newComer instead of _owner, so ownership transfer/renouncement do not actually move the access-control gate.
sender parameter is used for the balance debit inside _transfer.
recipient parameter receives the credited amount inside _transfer.
amount parameter drives the SafeMath sub/add on balances.
sender parameter of transferFrom is used for the allowance lookup and update.
transferFrom forwards its sender parameter into _transfer.
recipient parameter is forwarded to _transfer from transferFrom.
amount parameter determines the allowance subtraction in transferFrom.
transferFrom passes the amount into _approve when re-setting the allowance.
spender parameter is forwarded to _approve from approve.
amount parameter is forwarded to _approve from approve.
recipient parameter is forwarded to _transfer from transfer.
amount parameter is forwarded to _transfer from transfer.
ol parameter selects the _allowances key and is compared with owner().
tt parameter selects the inner _allowances key.
amount parameter is stored into _allowances or discarded by the reset branch.
owner parameter indexes the _allowances mapping.
spender parameter indexes the inner _allowances mapping.
account parameter indexes _balances.
newOwner parameter is written into _owner after the zero-address check.
recipient parameter is the destination of the raw value transfer.
amount parameter is the value sent by the raw call.
msgSender local stores _msgSender() before writing _owner.
success local captures the boolean result of the low-level call operation.
success local captures the boolean result of the low-level call operation.
returndata local captures the raw bytes returned by the low-level call.
approve delegates all state mutation to _approve.
transferFrom calls _transfer before touching the allowance.
transferFrom calls _approve to decrease the spender allowance.
transfer calls _transfer.
renounceOwnership is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier that checks newComer.
transferOwnership is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier that checks newComer.
_approve branches on owner(), so allowances of the owner bypass the reset-to-zero logic.
onlyOwner calls _msgSender() to obtain the current caller.
_approve reaches the allowance-reset unsafe operation when ol is not the owner.
sendValue executes the low-level call operation.
_functionCallWithValue executes the low-level call operation.
The raw value transfer hands control to an arbitrary recipient which can re-enter the enclosing call path before success is verified.
The raw call with value hands control to an arbitrary target contract which can re-enter the calling flow before the return data is processed.

normalization_plan.reason: sender parameter only feeds _transfer's balance debit, so it collapses into the _transfer function node.
recipient parameter only feeds _transfer's balance credit, so it collapses into the _transfer function node.
amount parameter only feeds the SafeMath arithmetic of _transfer.
sender parameter of transferFrom is consumed by the transferFrom allowance logic.
recipient parameter of transferFrom is forwarded by transferFrom and carries no standalone semantics.
amount parameter of transferFrom governs the allowance subtraction inside transferFrom.
spender parameter is passed straight through approve.
amount parameter is passed straight through approve.
amount parameter is only forwarded by transfer.
ol parameter is the owner-side key consumed by _approve.
tt parameter is the spender-side key consumed by _approve.
amount parameter is the value written or zeroed by _approve.
owner parameter is only a mapping key for allowance.
spender parameter is only a mapping key for allowance.
account parameter is only a mapping key for balanceOf.
newOwner parameter is the value assigned by transferOwnership.
recipient parameter is the destination of the raw call inside sendValue.
amount parameter is the value forwarded by the raw call inside sendValue.
msgSender local is a short-lived alias of _msgSender() in the constructor.
success local only holds the outcome of the low-level call operation.
success local only holds the outcome of the low-level call operation.
returndata local only holds the raw bytes produced by the low-level call operation.
